info.title: iris
info.description: A user's agents, which they can add, and their threads: each agent's one-to-one thread and groups of agents. In a thread the user sends posts, and the members named with @, or all of them when none is, reply with runs; an agent's scheduled tasks also start runs in its one-to-one thread. /api/agents/{agentId}/messages, runs and events work on the agent's one-to-one thread. Errors are { message }, except 401, which comes from the OAuth layer. GET /api/threads/{threadId}/events with a WebSocket upgrade opens a socket that sends the thread's posts, its runs as they change, and how the one being carried on is getting on (RunEvent); /api/agents/{agentId}/events does the same for the agent's one-to-one thread without posts.

iris.description: Sign in through the sheet at /authorize with resource set to the /api URL, using PKCE.

oneOf.description: A run started, got a message, or ended or failed an attempt: the run as it is now
How a run being carried on is getting on. A socket that opens during a run hears the latest at once. Writing comes at most every 100 ms; the run's next run event has the whole message.
A post was sent in the thread. Only a socket opened at /api/threads/{threadId}/events hears these; the runs that reply to it follow as run events

RunEvent.description: One event on the WebSocket at /api/threads/{threadId}/events, or at /api/agents/{agentId}/events for the agent's one-to-one thread without posts, which the app opens with the same token as /api. The server sends these as JSON text; the app sends nothing. Nothing is sent about what happened before the socket opened, apart from the progress of a run being carried on: open the socket, then read the runs.

agentId.description: The agent it is a run of

taskId.description: The task that started it; null when a post did

postId.description: The post it replies to, which is also its first message; null when a task started it

consults.description: The consults its agent asked in, the first asked first

input.description: The tool's input: any JSON value

callId.description: The ask_agent tool call that asked

name.description: The group's name, the agent's in its one-to-one thread, or in a consult the agent asked

agentId.description: The agent whose one-to-one thread this is; null for a group or a consult

consultRunId.description: For a consult, the run whose agent asked in it; null otherwise. A consult is only for reading

agentIds.description: The members, in the order they were added as agents

lastActivityAt.description: When it was made, a post was sent, or a run started, whichever came last

oneOf.description: The model is asked, and hasn't written anything of this message yet
The model is writing; text is the message so far

agentId.description: The agent that asked it in a consult; null when the user said it

Post.description: What was said in a thread: by the user, or in a consult by the agent that asked

oneOf.description: The user's mail setup changed: an address was made or let go, Gmail's forwarding confirmation arrived or was let go, or mail arrived. Read /api/me/mail again

UserEvent.description: One event on the WebSocket at /api/me/events, which the app opens with the same token as /api while it is in the foreground. The server sends these as JSON text; the app sends nothing. Nothing is sent about what happened before the socket opened: open the socket, then read what it is about.

name.description: The name the user's invite gave them

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone such as Asia/Tokyo, as the device is set to

address.description: Where the user forwards mail for their agents to read; null until one is made

url.description: The link that confirms the address to Gmail. Forwarding is then turned on in Gmail's settings

code.description: The code that confirms it in Gmail's settings instead, if any

confirmation.description: Gmail's forwarding confirmation for the address, from when it arrives until mail arrives after it or the app lets it go; null otherwise

forwardingAccount.description: The Gmail account that last asked to forward to the address, whose settings turn forwarding on; null until a confirmation names one

lastMailAt.description: When mail other than Gmail's confirmation last arrived at the address; null until the first does

MailSetup.description: Where the user's mail setup stands

lastRanAt.description: When its latest run started; null until it first runs

active.description: False while it is deactivated: it replies to nothing and its tasks don't run, but everything it has stays

Look.description: How an agent's orb is drawn: one of the app's palettes, taken modulo how many the app has, and the seed of its noise

ThreadEntry.description: A post or a run of a thread
